# TensorsLab Vision Skills

> Executable TensorsLab image and video API skills with a review-first local production planner.

This is an experimental navigation file, not a ranking signal. Prefer the linked source and capability matrix when verifying behavior.

## Capability boundary

- Implemented: image/video task submission, status polling, downloads, request dry-runs, and local workflow records.
- Workflow only: listing kits, creative batches, multi-ratio plans, and SKU plans; commands run one task at a time.
- Best effort: prompt-driven retouching, watermark/object removal, and face transformation through a general image-to-image endpoint. This is not a dedicated faceswap, face-swap, or deepfake pipeline.
- Not implemented: exact masked editing, deterministic typography, parallel batch execution, browser UI, and managed collaboration.
